edges.reason: renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner, which compares _owner against the untrusted msg.sender.
transferOwnership authorizes the caller through onlyOwner using the untrusted msg.sender.
WattToken.Mint is restricted by onlyOwner, so msg.sender decides who may mint new supply.
The WattToken constructor passes msg.sender as the account receiving the initial minted supply.
The newOwner parameter flows into _transferOwnership and overwrites the privileged _owner state.
The _to parameter determines the recipient of newly minted tokens in Mint.
The _amount parameter determines how many tokens Mint creates.
The spender parameter defines whose allowance increaseAllowance raises.
The recipient parameter is credited inside _transfer.
The amount parameter is debited from sender and credited to recipient in _transfer.
Mint delegates the supply creation to the internal _mint routine.
renounceOwnership writes address(0) into the privileged _owner state variable.
_transferOwnership writes the new owner into the privileged _owner state variable.
_transfer updates the _balances mapping for both sender and recipient.
_mint credits the recipient entry of the _balances mapping.
_mint adds amount to _totalSupply, an unchecked-style accumulation that relies on SafeMath.
_approve writes the new allowance into the _allowances nested mapping.
increaseAllowance performs its allowance update through _approve.
decreaseAllowance performs its allowance update through _approve.
transfer delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the spender allowance through _approve.
_burnFrom destroys tokens by calling _burn.
_burnFrom reduces the caller allowance by calling _approve.
sendValue performs a low-level call forwarding all gas to recipient, allowing reentrant execution before state settles.
_functionCallWithValue performs a low-level call with value and data to an arbitrary target, handing control to untrusted code.
The WattToken constructor uses initialSupply as the amount passed to _mint.
owner() reads and returns the _owner state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a parameter whose only purpose is to be written into _owner by _transferOwnership, so it is subsumed by that core function.
_to is the recipient parameter of the core Mint entry point and has no independent identity.
_amount is the amount parameter of the core Mint entry point and is fully determined by that function.
spender is a parameter of allowance-manipulating functions and is directly bound to the core increaseAllowance flow.
recipient is only meaningful as the credit target inside the core _transfer routine.
amount is only meaningful as the moved value inside the core _transfer routine.
